detached_structure.evidence: A small structure with a pyramidal tan roof sits on the west side of the lot, separate from the main house; it looks like a gazebo or small shed.

signals.notes: The large multi-section building has a flat gray roof, partly shaded and cluttered with rooftop equipment on the west wing. Dead grass lawn, trees on the south and east sides, and a paved drive at the north edge of the lot. The blue pool to the southwest belongs to a neighbor.
